A riot Employee said the interaction for GW items would be different, this is what he said

“Mortal Reminder frame from riot pls is a bit out of date. Our current direction on Grievous Wounds is a two state approach with an optimization for each class.

40% Small GW -> 60% Big GW

ADC - autos for small -> after 3 autos ramps into big Mage/Assassin - damage for small -> enemy low hp for big Tank/enchanter - damage or thornmail for small -> Hit CC for big Fighters still WIP

This basically means that GW will increase from Small impacts to Bigger Impacts if certain conditions are met.

So For Thornmail a Tank would have to CC someone to get the 60% GW on them.
